svg.text: AI PRODUCT TOOLKIT
convincer.io · Team cais-26
Product learning report
An argument about value and uncertainty — not an activity log.
01 / PRODUCT AND VALUE
convincer.io
An AI-assisted job application tool that helps people tailor
their CV to a specific role without losing their own voice.
WHO WE HELP
Job seekers who spend significant time adapting applications
to increasingly specific job descriptions.
JOB TO BE DONE
Present relevant experience clearly for a particular role while
keeping the application accurate and recognizably personal.
MAIN VALUE HYPOTHESIS
If we help job seekers tailor their CV to a role,
we expect less application effort and more interview invitations
while maintaining factual accuracy and user control.
WHAT THIS REPORT CONTAINS
02–03 Product dimensions and the reasoning behind them
04 AI Safety questions and assumptions
05 Self-Improvement loop and capability explanations
06–07 Hypothesis backlog, priorities, and next learning step
Workshop snapshot · 9 October 2026 · Product type: AI-native
Learning report · Intended product behavior, not proven product quality
